task: REAL POLAR STATION ENERGY / GRID DATA RECONNAISSANCE + FROZEN-INTERFACE COMPATIBILITY AUDIT

primary_research_question.question: Can POLARIS ingest a REAL MEASURED POLAR RESEARCH-STATION ELECTRICAL DEMAND/LOAD time series through the existing data/state interfaces while leaving the frozen EMS architecture untouched?
primary_research_question.data_availability_barrier: No open-access, unconstrained, 1-hour resolution measured time-series of total electrical demand for an active Antarctic research station was located in public repositories. Available real datasets are either monthly aggregated (AADC) or access-restricted (SANAE IV, PEA, ACEP).
primary_research_question.conclusion: No frozen-contract incompatibility was identified during reconnaissance; adapter feasibility appears possible, subject to obtaining and validating the required high-resolution measurements.

measurement_semantic_distinctions.station_electrical_demand: Total electrical load consumed by station systems (W). Ingested by POLARIS demand interface.
measurement_semantic_distinctions.solar_irradiance: Downward shortwave solar radiation (W/m^2). Solar PV model input, NOT station demand.
measurement_semantic_distinctions.solar_generation: Power produced by solar PV array (W). Renewable generation input, NOT station demand.
measurement_semantic_distinctions.wind_generation: Power produced by wind turbine (W). Renewable generation input, NOT station demand.
measurement_semantic_distinctions.diesel_fuel_consumption: Fuel volume/mass rate (L/h). Operational cost metric, NOT station demand.
measurement_semantic_distinctions.grid_import_export: Utility grid power flow (W). Boundary flow metric, NOT station demand.

trajectory_completeness.explanation: No identified public dataset provides simultaneous measured telemetry for station demand, solar generation, wind generation, battery SOC, and diesel engine run state. Real measured demand remains the primary target; if integrated, a hybrid trajectory pairing real demand/irradiance with modelled storage and genset states is a possible future option.
modelled_components: Diesel engine status and run hours

synthetic_fixture_preservation.rule: Real-data scenarios will be strictly additive (new scenario files) and will never overwrite or replace synthetic regression fixtures.

decision_framework_answers.B_actual_measurement_data_publicly_acces: PARTIALLY (Publicly documented; high-resolution 1h datasets are access-restricted or monthly aggregated; Nuolja solar irradiance is publicly downloadable)
decision_framework_answers.C_exact_variables: AADC: Monthly kWh, fuel litres. ACEP: Hourly kW demand, wind kW, diesel kW. Nuolja: Hourly SW_IN W/m^2.
decision_framework_answers.D_demand_vs_generation_distinction: Station load = P_load (W). Irradiance = SW_IN (W/m^2). Wind/Solar = Generation (W). Fuel = Volume (L).
decision_framework_answers.F_adapter_feasible_without_frozen_change: No frozen-contract incompatibility was identified during reconnaissance; adapter feasibility appears possible, subject to obtaining and validating the required high-resolution measurements.
